description: Both palms joined in front of chest (Namaste) or dominant hand waving from forehead with open palm outward.
handshape: Flat open palms pressed together (Namaste) or open 'B' hand at forehead

steps.title: Starting Position
steps.detail: Bring both hands flat in front of the chest, fingers pointing upward.

steps.title: Namaste Gesture
steps.detail: Press palms and fingers gently together with a slight nod of the head.

steps.title: Alternative Wave
steps.detail: Alternatively, place dominant hand at forehead and sweep gently outward with a warm smile.

linguistic_notes: In Indian Sign Language (ISL), 'Namaste' carries deep cultural reverence and is widely preferred in formal and polite settings across India.

description: Fingertips of dominant flat hand touch chin and move forward and slightly downward toward the listener.
handshape: Flat open hand with fingers together, thumb relaxed

steps.title: Touch Chin
steps.detail: Touch the tips of your dominant fingers lightly to your chin or lower lip.

steps.title: Forward Sweep
steps.detail: Move your hand smoothly outward and slightly downward toward the person you are thanking.

steps.title: Nod
steps.detail: Accompany with a pleasant facial expression and slight forward nod of gratitude.

linguistic_notes: The outward motion indicates transferring appreciation from oneself to the receiver. Non-manual facial markers reinforce sincere courtesy.

description: Open flat palm rubbed in a circular clockwise motion against chest.

steps.title: Placement
steps.detail: Place flat dominant palm against center of upper chest.

steps.title: Circular Rub
steps.detail: Rub palm in a clockwise circular motion 2-3 times.

steps.title: Facial Expression
steps.detail: Soften facial expression with gentle eyebrow posture to indicate earnest request.

linguistic_notes: The circular motion against the chest symbolizes heartfelt sincerity. Used before asking for assistance or permission.

description: Dominant hand closed in a fist with thumb up, placed on the open palm of non-dominant hand, lifting both upward together.
handshape: Dominant thumbs-up fist on flat non-dominant palm base

steps.title: Base Hand
steps.detail: Extend non-dominant hand flat, palm facing upward at stomach height.

steps.title: Dominant Fist
steps.detail: Form a fist with dominant hand, thumb upright, and place on non-dominant palm.

steps.title: Upward Lift
steps.detail: Lift both hands upward together toward yourself for 'Help me', or toward peer for 'Help you'.

linguistic_notes: In ISL, directional signs alter their target based on spatial movement: lifting inward toward your torso denotes requesting assistance.

description: Dominant hand formed into an 'S' fist, nodding up and down from the wrist like a nodding head.
handshape: Closed fist with thumb across front fingers (nodding head metaphor)

steps.title: Form Fist
steps.detail: Hold dominant hand in a relaxed fist at shoulder height.

steps.title: Wrist Nod
steps.detail: Flex wrist downward and upward twice, mimicking the movement of an affirming head.

steps.title: Head Agreement
steps.detail: Synchronize with a natural nod of your head.

linguistic_notes: The fist acts as a visual representation of the human head affirming agreement. Crucial response in everyday dialog.

description: Index and middle fingers snap down quickly against the thumb, like an emphatic negation.
handshape: Index and middle fingers extended, then pinching down to thumb

steps.title: Extend Fingers
steps.detail: Extend index and middle fingers together, thumb held open below them.

steps.title: Snap Closed
steps.detail: Snap index and middle fingertips briskly down against the pad of the thumb.

steps.title: Head Shake
steps.detail: Accompany with a slight head shake and furrowed brows.

linguistic_notes: The crisp closure signifies an emphatic negative response. Used universally in ISL for denial or disagreement.

description: Sign 'Good' (dominant flat hand from chin forward) followed by 'Morning' (dominant hand rising up from behind horizontal non-dominant arm like sunrise).
handshape: Compound sign: Flat hand (Good) + Rising sunrise hand (Morning)

steps.title: Sign 'Good'
steps.detail: Touch dominant fingertips to chin and bring forward onto flat non-dominant hand.

steps.title: Horizon Setup
steps.detail: Lay non-dominant forearm horizontally across chest to represent the horizon.

steps.title: Sunrise Rise
steps.detail: Raise dominant curved hand upward from behind the forearm, visualizing sunrise.

linguistic_notes: Compound signs in ISL blend two core conceptual signs smoothly. The sunrise motion visually reflects the morning sun.

description: Both open hands facing upward sweeping gently inward toward the body.
handshape: Both palms open and cupped slightly upward

steps.title: Open Posture
steps.detail: Hold both open palms slightly upward away from the body at waist level.

steps.title: Inward Arc
steps.detail: Draw both hands in a smooth inviting arc toward your torso.

steps.title: Welcoming Smile
steps.detail: Pair with welcoming eye contact and an open torso posture.

linguistic_notes: The inward sweeping arc represents inviting guests into one's home or gathering space. Warm and hospitable.

description: Both hands curved forward opening outward toward conversation partner with questioning facial expression.
handshape: Curved 'C' hands rolling outward into open palms toward listener

steps.title: Initial Curved Hands
steps.detail: Position both curved hands in front of chest, backs of fingers touching.

steps.title: Roll Outward
steps.detail: Roll hands outward so palms face upward and forward toward your partner.

steps.title: Questioning Expression
steps.detail: Tilt head slightly forward and lower eyebrows to signal a question.

linguistic_notes: In ISL grammatical questions, the facial marker (lowered eyebrows and tilted head) is mandatory to denote inquiry.

description: Open hand raised with palm outward, fingers waving toward conversation partner.
handshape: Open flat palm facing forward at shoulder height

steps.title: Raise Hand
steps.detail: Raise dominant hand to shoulder/head level, palm facing outward.

steps.title: Wave Fingers
steps.detail: Wave fingers gently back and forth toward your conversational partner.

steps.title: Departure Nod
steps.detail: Maintain warm eye contact with a parting head nod.

linguistic_notes: Standard departure greeting across Indian Deaf communities, recognized across all regional dialects.
